subject: Discovery recap — Observability & evals (dashboards, tracing, golden prompts)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Singh <samir.singh@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap — Observability & evals (dashboards, tracing, golden prompts)

Samir — great to meet today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap from our conversation and suggested next steps so we’re aligned.

Pain points you called out:
- Hard to detect prompt regressions after model/rollout changes (false positives/negatives in manual checks)
- Limited visibility into per-route token cost and tail latency for generation routes
- Lack of tracing hooks to connect application requests to generated outputs for debugging and audits
- Need to correlate eval drops with specific prompt changes and model versions for compliance reviews

Current stack you described:
- Front-end: Next.js microservices
- Orchestration: internal k8s clusters in GCP (us-central1)
- Existing models: combination of in-house fine-tuned models + third-party APIs (hybrid)
- Observability: Datadog for infra, limited custom logs for LLM calls (no dedicated dashboards today)

Success criteria for a 6–8 week eval you mentioned:
1) Ability to run an offline eval suite (golden prompt set) and detect regressions with >=90% precision for major intent classes
2) Per-route dashboards showing token cost, p50/p95 latency, and error rates for generation/chat routes
3) Tracing hook integration so an LLM call can be traced from request -> token stream -> stored KV/response in logs for incident debugging
4) Rollout guardrails: automatic rollback to previous model variant on regression alerts during canary (configurable thresholds)

What Redwood will deliver for the eval (proposal):
- Shared golden prompt set template + example CSV (attached) and a runner to automate daily evaluations
- Per-route observability dashboards pre-configured for ZenHealth (token costs, latency heatmaps, regression alerts)
- Tracing hooks: SDK snippets to add request IDs and correlation ids into LLM calls; sampling guidance for production
- Rollout guardrail configuration and a canary policy template (automatic rollback on eval/regression threshold breach)
- Mutual action plan with milestones and deliverables (attached)

Immediate next steps (for this week):
1) You to confirm the three intent classes we should prioritize for the golden prompt set (suggest: appointment booking, billing inquiry, triage)
2) Rishi/Neha to schedule a 60-min technical kick-off with your infra and security teams (we need to validate tracing integration & data flow)
3) Samir to introduce procurement contact for any NDAs/contract preliminaries if needed

Attachments: redwood-observability-overview.pdf; golden-prompt-examples.csv; mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If that matches your read, I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the tech kick-off and drop the golden prompt template.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Singh <samir.singh@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace Lin <grace.lin@zenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Observability & evals (dashboards, tracing, golden prompts)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap, this looks great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Intent classes: confirm we want appointment booking, billing inquiry, and symptom triage as the three priority buckets.
- For the golden prompts, we’ll include ~150 examples across the three intents (mix of canonical + edge cases). We’ll share a first pass by Friday.
- Tracing: our infra team prefers carrier headers (x-request-id) and we’ll need the SDK snippet to be language-agnostic (Node + Python).
- Rollout guardrails: can we test rollback behavior in a staging canary before we touch prod? Ideally a dry-run option.

Procurement and security: I’m looping in Grace (security lead) and procurement alias. Grace — can you confirm if a standard SaaS DPA + SOC 2 report will cover the initial eval? If not, we’ll coordinate.

Next: please send the tech kick-off invite and the golden prompt template. Also copy procurement for NDA/PO discussions.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Product Manager | ZenHealth
samir.singh@zenhealth.com

From: Grace Lin <grace.lin@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Singh <samir.singh@zenhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@zenhealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Observability & evals (dashboards, tracing, golden prompts)

Thanks Samir/Marissa — quick notes from security: 

- SOC 2 and a redacted runbook for incident response will be sufficient for the eval kick-off. We’ll request any additional artifacts through secure file share.
- For tracing hooks, we need to understand what PII (if any) is persisted in logs. Please include a data classification matrix for the eval.
- Can you include an overview of retention controls for traces/logs per environment (staging vs prod)?

I’ll review documents once they’re uploaded and coordinate with procurement for an NDA.

Regards,
Grace Lin
Security Lead | ZenHealth
grace.lin@zenhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Singh <samir.singh@zenhealth.com>, Grace Lin <grace.lin@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@zenhealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Observability & evals (dashboards, tracing, golden prompts)

Perfect — thanks all. Action items from my side:
- I’ll upload SOC 2 summary, data classification matrix, and retention controls to the secure share by EOD today and ping Grace.
- Rishi/Neha will send SDK snippets (Node/Python) and a staging dry-run guide for rollback testing before EOD Thursday.
- I’ll send a calendar invite for the 60-min tech kick-off for Friday 10:00 AM PT (tentative) — please let me know conflicts.
- Samir — once you send the golden prompt CSV I’ll wire it into the eval runner and share initial results within 48 hours.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
